month_theme: Phase 1, Week 1 — return from Austin and launch the grind

must_do.text: Launch the routine on Aug 6 — the no-travel block starts the day you return from Austin. Not the next Monday. That afternoon or first thing Aug 7: confirm your daily schedule times and begin. C++/CS50P block + Portuguese A2 prep + fitness (Krav Maga + cardio/weights) + flight sim. Day 1 of the real work block.

Open brokerage account by end of week — custodial with parents, Fidelity or Schwab. Monthly goal is first ETF purchase by Aug 15. The account must be open this week to hit that deadline. Don't let it slip to next week.

Start internship application research — identify your 3 top aerospace targets from: Impulse Space, Orbit Fab, Astroscale, Rocket Lab, True Anomaly, Intuitive Machines. Confirm China program name and application requirements. One focused hour. Sep 30 has 4 deadlines and they don't write themselves.

should_do.text: First C++/CS50P session — read learncpp.com Chapter 1, start CS50P Problem Set 0. Get the counter running. August target is PS 0-2 complete + Chapter 5 reached.
Resolve Peru/Japan date overlap — Peru ends Dec 18, Japan starts Dec 15. Three days conflict. Decision: trim Peru to Dec 14 or confirm Japan starts Dec 16+. Pick one and update Notion.

could_do.text: Decide Europe route — Option A: Lisbon → Porto → Madrid → Paris → London (Eurostar). Option B: Prague → Vienna → Budapest → Amsterdam → London. Oct 1 is 8 weeks out. Lock it in and start looking at rail passes.
Set up Portuguese A2 resource — install Duolingo or find a structured A2 course. 10 min/day is the Phase 1 target. Set the habit before the routine is locked in.

key_dates.event: Return from Austin — no-travel block begins. Routine Day 1.
Brokerage account must be open by today
First ETF purchase deadline (next week — account must be open now)

notes: Phase 1 officially running since Aug 1. This is the transition week: half Austin, half grind. The Aug 1 monthly email set four priorities — all need their first concrete steps this week. Sep 30 has 4 simultaneous deadlines (3× aerospace internship apps + engineering proposal + China internship app). Every week from now through September builds toward those. The routine has to be automatic by Sep 1.
